# DAVMEL Remodeling

> Licensed residential remodeling contractor based in Denver, Pennsylvania (PA HIC #PA214721), serving Lancaster County and Chester County within about 75 miles. One in-house crew handles interior and exterior work: bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, basement finishing, drywall and plaster, tile installation, framing, interior doors and trim, deck building, window and door installation, and porch restoration.

Key facts:
- Owner: David Melnychuk, 6+ years in the Pennsylvania trades, company founded 2020
- Phone: +1 717 210 8194, Email: info@davmelremodeling.com
- Base: Denver, PA 17517. Primary markets: Lancaster, Ephrata, Lititz, Reading, Lebanon, Elizabethtown, West Chester, Downingtown, Coatesville
- Licensed and insured; registration verifiable at the PA Attorney General HIC search
- Free written estimates; deposits follow the PA one-third rule
- Typical 2026 pricing: hall bathroom remodel $12,000 to $22,000; basement finishing $35 to $75 per sq ft; composite decks $60 to $95 per sq ft

## Services
- [Interior remodeling](https://davmelremodeling.com/services/interior-remodeling): framing, drywall, tile, doors, trim, full rooms
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://davmelremodeling.com/services/bathroom-remodeling): waterproofed showers, tile, vanities
- [Basement finishing](https://davmelremodeling.com/services/basement-finishing): moisture-first process, egress compliance
- [Exterior remodeling](https://davmelremodeling.com/services/exterior-remodeling): decks, windows, doors, porches
